profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); social values weakly mixed
summary: Samar 1st District representative with about 58 principal-authored bills. Authored social security for informal-sector workers, price control on imported anticancer drugs, mental health units in district hospitals, a nationwide ban on online gambling and youth participation in adolescent pregnancy prevention policy. Co-authored national minimum wage and a P200 daily wage increase.
caveat: Social score rests on two weak signals; the gambling ban may be a harm-reduction rather than moral measure. Bill-list evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored social security for informal-sector workers (-3) and price control on anticancer drug imports plus district mental health units (-2); co-authored national minimum wage and a P200 wage increase (-2, discounted). Three issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04849, HB03868, HB04819; co-author HB08081, HB00094, HB00766 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Conservative
social.rationale: Youth participation in adolescent pregnancy prevention policy (+1) is mildly progressive; nationwide ban on online gambling (-2) is mildly conservative on moral regulation. Net slightly conservative; two issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01301, HB04820 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
